audit_items.proof_trace: Data columns from EL (engine_getBlobs) are inserted into DA cache after only slashability checks, skipping all REJECT validations (inclusion proof, parent block, finalized descendant, slot ordering, proposer index, KZG). When these cached columns arrive via gossip, they are accepted at L491-499 early exit without running the remaining REJECT checks (L502-522), violating the property that accepted sidecars must pass all REJECT checks in order.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Malicious EL provides invalid data columns (wrong inclusion proof, invalid proposer, bad KZG proof) via engine_getBlobsV2. CL caches them without validation. When attacker gossips the same column, CL accepts and propagates it to the network without running REJECT checks, polluting the gossip network with invalid data that fails spec validation.
